sentence_stem: Not only did the team finish the project early,
correct_completion: but they also reduced the costs significantly.
full_sentence: Not only did the team finish the project early, but they also reduced the costs significantly.
acceptable_variants: but they also improved the quality of the final report.
but they also exceeded every target set by the managers.

options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result. The stem uses 'not only', which needs a second emphatic addition, not a consequence.

options.text: but they also reduced the costs significantly.
because the manager asked for it.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' gives a reason. 'Not only ... but also' needs a parallel addition about the same subject.
'Although' introduces a concession. 'Not only ... but also' emphasises an additional achievement instead.

grammar_focus: Emphatic correlative structure 'not only ... but also' with inversion
explanation: The stem uses the correlative pair 'not only' followed by an inverted auxiliary, so the completion must add a second, parallel achievement introduced by 'but also'.
acceptable_variants: but they also improved the quality of the final report.
but they also exceeded every target set by the managers.
translation: Ekip projeyi yalnızca erken bitirmekle kalmadı, aynı zamanda maliyetleri önemli ölçüde de azalttı.
